none: PAS CAM-D5B4F4: Roman Coin : Copper-alloy Nummus of the House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A copper-alloy nummus of the House of Constantine. Mint is Lyon, AD330-331, (Reece period 17). Reverse legend reads -. Reverse shows Wolf and twins. See RIC VII, p.138, no.242. Obverse shows helmeted Roma left. Obverse legend reads VRBS ROMA. Reverse fields and exergue read: -/-//SLG. Die axis is 6 o'clock, weight is 2.30g, diameter is 17.66mm
